description: Measure camera-to-visible-surface depth of a candidate that you have already identified in the CURRENT RGB. Call only when the image itself supplies direct evidence of that candidate and a distance would change the next decision. Never call to discover, search for, or test the presence of a target or landmark, and never copy an unseen object from the instruction into the query. Returns candidate locations, annotated evidence and distance validity; it does not establish task identity, interpret routes or decide completion. Query only a category and appearance directly supported by the image. An empty candidate list is a failed measurement, not evidence that an object is absent. A detector match does not confirm identity. Distance is camera-to-visible-surface depth, not horizontal or target-center distance. inconsistent_depth_surfaces invalidates the scalar distance; metric_depth_unavailable means metric depth could not be used. Execution success does not imply a valid measurement. An error or rejected result is a failed call, not negative scene evidence. No mandatory approach-time or completion-time measurement is imposed.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise category and appearance of the candidate already identified in CURRENT RGB, e.g. brown-walled building or beige flat roof. Do not copy an unseen instruction object, add invented attributes or alternative identities, or encode task-relative relations such as directly below the UAV.
